Let

\[
A=\int_0^\pi x^3\log(\sin x)\,dx,
\qquad
B=\int_0^\pi x^2\log(\sqrt2\sin x)\,dx.
\]

We use the standard Fourier series

\[
\log(2\sin x)=-\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\cos(2nx)}{n},\qquad 0<x<\pi.
\]

Hence

\[
\log(\sin x)=-\log 2-\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\cos(2nx)}{n},
\]

and

\[
\log(\sqrt2\sin x)=\log(2\sin x)-\frac12\log 2
=-\frac12\log 2-\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\cos(2nx)}{n}.
\]

Now compute the needed cosine moments. For \(a\neq 0\),

\[
\int_0^\pi x^2\cos(ax)\,dx
=\left[\frac{x^2\sin(ax)}{a}+\frac{2x\cos(ax)}{a^2}-\frac{2\sin(ax)}{a^3}\right]_0^\pi.
\]

With \(a=2n\), this gives

\[
\int_0^\pi x^2\cos(2nx)\,dx=\frac{\pi}{2n^2}.
\]

Similarly,

\[
\int_0^\pi x^3\cos(ax)\,dx
=\left[
\frac{x^3\sin(ax)}{a}
+\frac{3x^2\cos(ax)}{a^2}
-\frac{6x\sin(ax)}{a^3}
-\frac{6\cos(ax)}{a^4}
\right]_0^\pi,
\]

and with \(a=2n\),

\[
\int_0^\pi x^3\cos(2nx)\,dx=\frac{3\pi^2}{4n^2}.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\int_0^\pi x^2\log(2\sin x)\,dx
=-\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2n^2}
=-\frac{\pi}{2}\zeta(3),
\]

and

\[
\int_0^\pi x^3\log(2\sin x)\,dx
=-\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n}\cdot\frac{3\pi^2}{4n^2}
=-\frac{3\pi^2}{4}\zeta(3).
\]

Thus the numerator is

\[
A=\int_0^\pi x^3\log(\sin x)\,dx
=-\frac{3\pi^2}{4}\zeta(3)-\log 2\int_0^\pi x^3\,dx
\]

so

\[
A=-\frac{3\pi^2}{4}\zeta(3)-\frac{\pi^4}{4}\log 2
=-\frac{\pi^2}{4}\left(3\zeta(3)+\pi^2\log 2\right).
\]

For the denominator,

\[
B=\int_0^\pi x^2\log(\sqrt2\sin x)\,dx
=-\frac12\log 2\int_0^\pi x^2\,dx
-\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n}\int_0^\pi x^2\cos(2nx)\,dx,
\]

so

\[
B=-\frac{\pi^3}{6}\log 2-\frac{\pi}{2}\zeta(3)
=-\frac{\pi}{6}\left(3\zeta(3)+\pi^2\log 2\right).
\]

Hence

\[
\frac{A}{B}
=
\frac{-\frac{\pi^2}{4}\left(3\zeta(3)+\pi^2\log 2\right)}
{-\frac{\pi}{6}\left(3\zeta(3)+\pi^2\log 2\right)}
=
\frac{\pi^2/4}{\pi/6}
=
\frac{3\pi}{2}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{3\pi}{2}}
\]
